name: Holden Beach official public parks
source: Town of Holden Beach Parks & Recreation list and 2021 Comprehensive Parks and Recreation Master Plan. See data/notes/official-parks-inventory.json.

properties.name: Block Q Pavilion (Stage & Picnic Shelter)
properties.address: 82 South Shore Drive (pavilion/stage); restrooms also listed as Block Q — 101 Brunswick Avenue East
properties.location_description: Town-owned Block Q lot near the Holden Beach Bridge, bordered by Jordan Boulevard, South Shore Drive, Quinton Street, and Brunswick Avenue. Across from the Intracoastal boat ramp. Replaces the old Jordan Boulevard Pavilion, which was demolished in 2024. New venue opened July 2026; ribbon cutting 4 September 2026.
properties.precision_note: Census missed 82 South Shore Dr. Point is the midpoint of Block Q's South Shore frontage (between Jordan Blvd at about -78.26729, 33.91582 and Quinton St at -78.26625, 33.91616), slightly south of the centerline onto the lot. 101 Brunswick Ave E census: -78.266083, 33.915235 (SE corner of the same block).
sources: Brunswick Beacon 2026-09-10 (82 South Shore Drive; bordered by Jordan, South Shore, Quinton, Brunswick)
properties.pavilion_note: Per Keith 2026-11-15: the town pavilion is here now; the old pavilion at 131 Jordan Blvd is gone.

properties.name: Bridgeview Park
properties.address: 124 Davis Street (also cited as 125 Davis Street for the transient dock)
properties.location_description: Adjacent to Town Hall, on the sound / ICW side of the island. The Master Plan describes basketball/pickleball courts, splash pad, picnic shelter, playground with shade sails, bocce, open green space, canoe/kayak launches, and a transient boat dock. This is the same block as the water tower (OSM node 5366751196), at the Brunswick Avenue end, across Brunswick Avenue from Town Hall.
properties.precision_note: way/221137958, tagged 'Holden Beach Park' — name is generic/outdated; geometry matches the Bridgeview Park block between Davis St, Rothschild St, and Brunswick Ave.

properties.name: Butterfly Garden
properties.address: Along the back of the Holden Beach Fire Station (Tri-Beach VFD Station 8-2)
properties.location_description: Master Plan: town partnership with the Holden Beach Beautification Club; picnic table and seating behind the fire station. OSM places that station on the ocean side of mid-island, next to Starfish Drive / near Sand Dollar Drive.
properties.precision_note: way/556341605 Tri-Beach VFD Station 8-2. Garden is 'along the back' of this building — exact garden footprint not mapped; use the station as the anchor and offset slightly when drawing later.

properties.name: Halstead Park
properties.address: Halstead Street and South Shore Drive, on the Intracoastal Waterway
properties.location_description: Small passive park east of the bridge on the sound side. Master Plan: fishing dock, picnic shelter, and seating; a destination on the Olden Holden Bike Route. Beautification Club: public fishing pier and gazebo; ADA work in 2023–2024.
properties.precision_note: OSM intersection of Halstead Street (way/16421726) and South Shore Drive (way/16434005). Place slightly onto the ICW side of the intersection when drawing later.

properties.name: Padgett Garden
properties.address: North (sound) side of Ocean Boulevard East at the NC-130 / Holden Beach Road bridge landing corner
properties.location_description: Master Plan: at the intersection of Ocean Boulevard and Holden Beach Road as you cross the bridge and enter Holden Beach. Short walking path, seating, shade structures, landscaping, statuary, and a water feature with memorial stones. Beautification Club describes it as 'at the base of the bridge and OBW.'
properties.precision_note: Placed on the north (second-row, sound) side of Ocean Blvd East, in the corner east of where NC-130 / Holden Beach Road comes down onto Ocean Blvd (~32 m east of NC-130 and ~28 m north of Ocean Blvd E centerline; ~45 m NE of the OSM junction at -78.2693515, 33.9139318). Sources: Holden Beach Beautification Club 'Padgett Garden and Extension' page (holdenbeachbc.org/padgett-garden-and-extension/): 'NC130 and Ocean Blvd. On the left at the foot of the bridge as you drive onto the island'; HBBC posts 2017-12-18 and 2025-06-01 ('at the foot of the bridge and Ocean Blvd.'), HBBC 2024-10-23 ('at the base of the bridge and OBW'); 2021 Parks & Recreation Master Plan §2.1 (intersection of Ocean Blvd and Holden Beach Rd). Location per user: north side of Ocean Blvd E at the bridge landing corner (not Jordan Blvd, not the ocean side). Exact parcel footprint not in OSM. Do not confuse with Block Q or the under-bridge Jordan Blvd beds.
sources: Location per user (local): north/sound side of Ocean Blvd E at the bridge landing corner

properties.name: Pocket Park
properties.location_description: Master Plan: small passive park located midway on the island along Ocean Boulevard; landscaped seating and nature observation; a rest stop on the Olden Holden Bike Route. HBBC (town's landscaping partner, named in the Master Plan) gives the street address as 628 Ocean Blvd West: a small donated lot with a viewing deck overlooking the marsh.
properties.precision_note: US Census geocoder match for 628 OCEAN BLVD W, HOLDEN BEACH, NC, 28462. Sits on Ocean Blvd West mid-island, west of the pier, consistent with the Master Plan map cluster of Pocket Park / Butterfly Garden / Sand Dollar Park / Fit Trail.

properties.name: Sailfish Park
properties.address: 188 Sailfish Drive (also cited as 197 Sailfish Drive / 188 Sailfish Street)
properties.location_description: Master Plan: small passive park on the western end of the island along the sound / ICWW. Open space, fishing dock, picnic tables, nature observation, and a sand beach with water access. OSM name is Sailfish Park (way/1106981444) at the north end of Sailfish Drive.
sources: Hobbs Realty / launch guides (188/197 Sailfish Dr)

properties.name: Sand Dollar Park
properties.address: End of Sand Dollar Drive, on the Intracoastal Waterway (one launch guide also uses 169 Sand Dollar Drive)
properties.location_description: Master Plan: passive park at the end of Sand Dollar Drive, predominantly coastal marshland along the ICWW; open space, nature observation, informal canoe/kayak launch.
properties.precision_note: way/16421998 Sand Dollar Drive; the north/ICW end is (-78.3072773, 33.9148067). South end is at Ocean Blvd. Place at the ICW end.

properties.name: Holden Beach Fit Trail
properties.address: Along the sidewalk on Ocean Boulevard between Scotch Bonnet Drive and Greensboro Street
properties.location_description: Linear amenity: nine fitness stations along the Ocean Boulevard sidewalk between those two cross streets. Not a single parcel. When drawn later, treat as a line or a series of stations along Ocean Blvd West, not a point in the middle of a park.
properties.render: dashed line along Ocean Boulevard West between Scotch Bonnet Drive and Greensboro Street. Individual fitness-station positions are not known, so station dots were not invented.
